external_games.name: Tidy Up Ltd.: A Cozy Co-op Cleanup

name: Tidy Up Ltd.
storyline: A small cleaning company with a talent for magic sets out to become the most renowned tidying business in the kingdom. Client by client, from a little wizard's shop to the king's own castle, its letters and jobs tell the story of Tidy Up Ltd.'s rise from backyard business to legendary enterprise.
summary:
Tidy Up Ltd. is a cozy first-person co-op tidying game for 1 to 8 players. As a magical cleaning company, players take on jobs from fantasy clients and restore wrecked shops to order: a wizard's shop after a spell gone wrong, an inn after an army of knights stayed the night, a dwarven forge, a market and more. Players grab items lying around, toss them to each other and put every ware on the shelf where it belongs.

Nineteen locations across six themes come in three sizes, from small shops to large ones with over three thousand items, ending at Glanzenstein Castle. Between jobs, the crew returns to the company headquarters to spend their earnings on equipment and spells, rise through the ranks and buy new outfits, while a job book leads them from client to client. Online co-op runs via Steam, and players keep their own progress when joining a friend's game.
